title: Okanagan Bee Tour and Lunch at Winery in Kelowna
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the magic world of bees in the heart of the Okanagan!

Immerse yourself in the fascinating world of bees nestled in the orchards of Kelowna! You will try our award winning wines with a tour guide offering informative descriptions and unique tastings notes. 

The honey you will try comes directly from our bees on the farm! Raw and unpasteurized, and specialty infused. Our farm-to-table Bistro uses local, fresh ingredients directly from our farm and neighbouring local farms.

What’s Included:

• Guided bee tour
• Guided Honey wine tasting
• Raw and infused honey tasting
• Main course at Farm to Table Bistro (see the menu on photos!)
• Bottled water or local juice soda
• Lawn games in the Okanagan sunshine!
